pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with softened edge gradients; patch area is greatest on the upper flank and decreases toward the ventral and posterior margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial network with variable pixel width; intersections primarily show tri-point and tetra-point nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the mane on the dorsal neck region.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A single, dark, focal nodule with localized textural disruption is visible on the upper mid-flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small, raised, darkly pigmented nodular lesions on the upper posterior flank near the dorsal ridge.
